construction: within-sector (Date,Sector) z-score of canonical value/quality/momentum base factors (V12_Composite_Value, Q01_GPA, M01_Mom_12_1), equal-weight composite. Firm-specific signal isolated by removing sector mean. Contrast = same base factors composited market-wide.
sector_source: RAWDATA Sector column (QuantiWise/internal, KSI Level-1, 27 sectors, 96.8% non-NA). Slow-moving classification, PIT-safe at sig_date. QMJ factor-DB had Sector=NA; RAWDATA is the gold source — verified available.

factor_specs.formula: factor-DB composite value z, then within (Date,Sector) re-z
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Cross-industry P/E and book multiples are structurally non-comparable (banks vs software). Within-sector value ranking isolates relative mispricing from sector valuation regimes.

factor_specs.formula: gross profits/assets z, then within (Date,Sector) re-z
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Gross margins differ structurally across industries (software ~80% vs retail ~20%); raw GPA is partly a sector proxy. Within-sector GPA isolates firm operating quality.
references: Novy-Marx 2013 JFE (The Other Side of Value)

factor_specs.formula: 12-1 month return z, then within (Date,Sector) re-z
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Market-wide momentum is partly sector rotation. Within-sector momentum isolates firm-specific relative strength, reducing crowded sector-momentum exposure.

measurement.metric_type_authoritative: canonical_screen (canonical_screen_bt, top-N EW long-only, contract build_benchmark_compare NW lag-3). NOT proxy hand-calc. forge build_bt_result remains admission-binding authority.

diagnostics_out_of_sample_2024_2026.interpretation: RANK-IC OOS는 +0.0312로 양수(횡단면 순위력 잔존)이나 LONG-ONLY TOP-25 실현 portfolio-alpha는 OOS에서 REVERSAL(-1.665, net_sr -0.813). in-sample E3(2020-23) rank-IC -0.004 decay의 연장 — 최근 alpha decay 확정. Cycle 2 교훈(rank-IC vs portfolio-alpha 괴리) OOS 재현.

finding: 이 구성(within-sector V/Q/M EW top-25)에서 sector-relative ranking은 in-sample(2004-2023, N=238)에서 market-wide baseline 대비 canonical portfolio-alpha t를 2.379->3.424로 개선, composite는 best single sleeve(M01_sr 2.684) 대비 +27.6%. top20에서도 PORT_t 3.200(>2.95 hurdle), DSR(n=22) 0.906. 단 2024-2026 OOS(27m)에서 portfolio-alpha t -1.665로 REVERSAL — standalone alpha는 in-sample 강함, OOS 무너짐. rank-IC는 OOS도 +(0.0312)이나 long-only 실현 alpha 역전. monotonicity spearman 0.636(<0.7). active cor vs STR_1715 0.528(BAB/VALUE 0.76-0.78 대비 개선이나 <0.5 권고 미달).
honest_caveats: ★ OOS REVERSAL (최중요): 2024-2026 portfolio-alpha t = -1.665. in-sample 강도가 OOS로 전이 안 됨. standalone deployment 부적격.
rank-IC 0.0229 < 0.04 (advisory hurdle 미달). v8.x WS2: rank-IC advisory, portfolio-alpha t가 hard gate 권위. in-sample PORT_t는 hurdle 통과하나 OOS는 음수.
TO 7.0-8.2/yr: task cap 11 통과, base cap 6.0 초과 (implementation discipline borderline).
active cor 0.528 < 0.5 권고 미달, port cor 0.852 (beta 0.965). long-only 1st eigenmode 잔존 — measurement-graduation §6 정합.
verdict/공간폐쇄/소거 금지: 본 결과는 이 구성(N_in=238, N_oos=27, 3-factor within-sector EW top-25)의 실측. 다른 base factor set/horizon/cap-tier/sector_Lv2 미탐색. 포기 판단은 Q-Lead/도훈 권한.
